name: MorgenCraft Finance
author: morgencraft

sections.description:
MorgenCraft Finance is a WooCommerce cost of goods and profit dashboard that shows what your sales actually leave after product costs, shipping, payment fees, marketplace commission, refunds, advertising, and fixed business expenses.

Add purchase, production, labor, packaging, and other unit costs directly to WooCommerce products. Then review monthly net sales, net profit, profit margin, average order value, break-even, missing product costs, and order-level contribution profit.

The plugin runs entirely inside WordPress and does not transmit store, order, or customer data to an external service.

Free features

  • Add purchase, production, labor, packaging, and other unit costs to WooCommerce products.
  • Calculate net sales after refunds and sales tax.
  • Estimate product cost, shipping cost, payment fees, and marketplace commission.
  • Subtract monthly advertising and fixed business costs.
  • Show monthly profit, profit margin, average order value, and estimated break-even.
  • Identify sold products with missing cost information.
  • Review the contribution of recent orders.
  • Works with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
  • Includes English and Turkish translations.

Calculation notes

  • Reports include only the order statuses selected in MorgenCraft Finance settings.
  • Net sales are collected sales minus refunds and tax.
  • Product costs and per-order variable-cost rates are snapshotted on the order so later product or setting changes do not rewrite historical profit.
  • Product costs are multiplied by non-refunded quantity; fully refunded orders are excluded and counted separately.
  • Percentage fees are applied to the amount collected from the customer, including tax.
  • Monthly profit is net sales minus product costs, average shipping cost, percentage fees, advertising, and fixed costs.
  • The free version reports in the WooCommerce store currency. Orders in another currency are excluded and clearly counted.

MorgenCraft Finance is a management estimate, not statutory accounting or tax advice. Confirm official records with your accountant.

Privacy

MorgenCraft Finance does not collect telemetry and does not transmit order or customer data. The only external link is an optional link from the plugin’s own admin page to learn about MorgenCraft Finance Pro.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload the MorgenCraft Finance ZIP from Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin, or install it from the WordPress.org directory when available.
  3. Open MorgenCraft Finance > Settings and enter monthly costs and percentage fees.
  4. Edit WooCommerce products and enter unit costs in the Pricing section.
  5. Open MorgenCraft Finance to review the current month.
sections.faq:
Does the free plugin stop working after a trial?

No. The WordPress.org version is free, fully functional, and has no time limit.

Does it change product prices or stock?

No. MorgenCraft Finance Free only reads WooCommerce orders and stores cost metadata on products. It does not change selling prices, stock, order status, or customer data.

How are refunds handled?

Refunded revenue and refunded tax are removed from the report. When WooCommerce records refunded quantities, the related product cost is also reduced.

Does it support multiple currencies?

The free version reports in the WooCommerce store currency. Orders using another currency are excluded to prevent misleading totals. Multi-currency reporting is planned for MorgenCraft Finance Pro.

Is this accounting software?

No. It is an internal profitability and break-even dashboard. It does not replace bookkeeping, tax filings, or professional accounting advice.
sections.changelog:
1.0.13

  • Improved the WordPress.org short description, tags, and introduction for clearer WooCommerce cost-of-goods and profit reporting.
  • Clarified net profit, profit margin, break-even, refunds, and order-level profitability features.

1.0.12

  • Added professional WordPress.org screenshots for the finance dashboard, settings, product costs, recalculation tools, and order-level profitability.
  • Added matching screenshot descriptions to the plugin readme.

1.0.11

  • Shortened the public plugin name to MorgenCraft Finance for a cleaner WordPress.org install dialog and plugin list.
  • Prepared matching professional WordPress.org banner and icon assets without changing the plugin slug or data compatibility.

1.0.10

  • Added a deliberate monthly recalculation tool for orders that existed before product costs or finance settings were entered.
  • Keeps normal order snapshots immutable while allowing an administrator to refresh one explicitly selected month.
  • Refreshes product cost, shipping, payment fee, and marketplace commission snapshots, then clears the dashboard cache.

1.0.9

  • Fixed Turkish admin translations not loading from the bundled language files.
  • Added the compiled Turkish MO file.
  • Registered the plugin text domain during the WordPress init hook.

1.0.8

  • Hardened class loading with redeclaration guards for WordPress.org review safety.
  • Renamed internal include files to match the finalized MorgenCraft Finance prefix.
  • Updated package metadata for the review build.

1.0.7

  • Updated internal admin page slugs to match the finalized WordPress.org slug.
  • Confirmed plugin name, readme title, text domain, and language files use the finalized distinctive name.

1.0.5

  • Removed the duplicate Plugin URI header so the WordPress.org submission metadata is valid.

1.0.4

  • Finalized the WordPress.org plugin name and matching text domain.
  • Updated submission metadata for the morgencraft contributor account.

1.0.3

  • Resolved Plugin Check translation, nonce, sanitization, hook-prefix, and uninstall warnings.
  • Replaced direct uninstall database queries with WooCommerce CRUD for HPOS and legacy order storage.
  • Added nonce protection to the report-month selector.

1.0.2

  • Added immutable unit-cost snapshots to WooCommerce order items.
  • Preserved historical costs when products are edited or deleted.
  • Preserved past-month advertising and fixed-cost values.
  • Fixed full-refund detection and zero-value order classification.
  • Refreshed report caches after order or line-item edits without requiring a status change.
  • Reduced cache-version database writes during bulk imports.

1.0.1

  • Fixed escaped WooCommerce price markup in the break-even card.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release.
  • Product unit cost fields.
  • Refund-aware monthly profit dashboard.
  • HPOS compatibility declaration.
  • Break-even and missing-cost reports.
